component.name: Mutterboard
component.summary: Voice dictation straight to your clipboard

description.p: Press a global shortcut, speak, and get cleaned-up text on your clipboard, pasted into whatever you were typing. Transcription runs through Whisper V3 Turbo with a Llama cleanup pass (bring your own Groq key), or fully offline on your own machine with Parakeet and Qwen.

Every dictation is now saved to disk — audio and transcript — the moment you stop talking, before anything is sent anywhere. The new History section lists your recent dictations to copy again or re-transcribe from the original recording.

Long recordings are fixed: they no longer get cut off while the audio file is being finalized, are no longer mistaken for silence, and are split automatically when they exceed the cloud engine's upload limit. Failures now show a desktop notification instead of a message in a window you don't have open, and never delete the recording.
The tray icon turns orange while transcribing and is now symmetrical. The settings header shows the brand waveform without the white tile.
Check for updates and install them from the About section in settings. Removed the "Copied to clipboard" note after dictations.
Fix in-app shortcut rebinding inside the Flatpak sandbox.
First release: cloud and offline dictation, global shortcut, tray, custom vocabulary, recording cues, launch at login.
